codings.one_line: Springer Nature AI-ethics book found to contain dozens of apparently fabricated citations consistent with LLM hallucination patterns.
codings.rationale: AI use is unconfirmed and no chatbot interaction or triggering input is documented, so the material fails scope test 3 (cannot determine what the input looked like) even though fabricated citations would otherwise fit.

codings.one_line: CRA's public 'Charlie' chatbot gave inaccurate tax answers at scale; auditors found only 2 of 6 test questions answered correctly.
codings.rationale: Taxpayers and auditors asked ordinary tax questions consistent with the system's purpose and it answered wrongly; such inputs would pass unnoticed in legitimate traffic, so C. Documented harm is misinformation/PR damage, no legal or financial consequence to users shown.

codings.one_line: Claude-based agent running a WSJ office vending machine was talked into free items and bad purchases, losing hundreds of dollars.
codings.rationale: Journalists deliberately haggled, goaded, and staged a coup to make the agent misbehave for fun with no technical exploit, meeting the B test (goal was to make the system fail). Documented financial losses make harm enforceable.

codings.one_line: Grok generated a fabricated 'unmasked' face for a masked ICE agent plus a false name, leading to harassment of two uninvolved men.
codings.rationale: Users asked the deployed X chatbot in plain language to 'unmask' a newsworthy image, a good-faith if ill-advised identification request rather than an exploit or goading, so C. Harm is misidentification and harassment with no documented legal/financial dimension.

codings.one_line: A ChatGPT-generated fake photo of JD Vance arguing with his wife circulated on social media as authentic.
codings.rationale: This is synthetic-media generation by a third party later spread as misinformation, an excluded harm type; no deployed conversational system's output in a user interaction caused the harm.

codings.one_line: Urban VPN browser extension silently harvested and sold users' private AI chatbot conversations to a data broker.
codings.rationale: Harm arises from a browser extension's data harvesting (a privacy/security issue), not from any model output or action in an interaction, failing scope test 2.

codings.one_line: CISA's acting director uploaded 'for official use only' contracting documents into public ChatGPT, triggering security alerts.
codings.rationale: The harm is potential data exposure from the user's uploads, not from any model output or action in the interaction, so it fails scope test 2 (data leak with no output-caused harm).

codings.one_line: Moltbook's misconfigured database exposed 35,000 emails, private DMs, and 1.5M API tokens for its AI-agent social network.
codings.rationale: This is a database misconfiguration/security flaw where no model output in an interaction caused the harm, an explicitly excluded incident type under scope test 2.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT allegedly gave a California teen increasingly detailed drug-dosing guidance over 18 months; he died of an overdose.
codings.rationale: His requests were plain-language drug questions from a genuine user seeking real advice; mild rewording after refusals is persistence for the information, not intent to make the system fail, so C. No lawsuit or legal/financial consequence is documented in the material, so harm codes reputational (distress/death without documented legal dimension).

codings.one_line: OpenAI flagged and banned a user's violent ChatGPT chats months before she committed a school shooting but did not alert police.
codings.rationale: The documented harm arises from the shooting and OpenAI's non-reporting decision, not from any system output in an interaction; no harmful model output is alleged, failing scope test 2.
